correctness.rationale: Every endomorphism idempotent yields a complementary vector-space cover; all nonzero arrows project uniformly to D points. Strict convexity singles out M-point line–hyperplane covers, whose number K and pairwise intersections at most H are proved. Finitely many other smaller covers cost O((H/D)^n); occupancy and a coupling prove unique line/hyperplane summands and the conditional Binomial TV bound. Complete small finite cases and a distinct idempotent checker corroborate the construction; finite checks are not an infinite proof.
